sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "articles"."authref" AS e, "users"."gendlbl" AS g, AVG("articles"."accscore") AS m1, AVG(("articles"."contrscore" - "articles"."qualscore")) AS m2, (AVG("articles"."accscore") - AVG(("articles"."contrscore" - "articles"."qualscore"))) AS m3 FROM "articles" JOIN "users" ON "users"."userkey" = "articles"."authref"  GROUP BY "articles"."authref", "users"."gendlbl") SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, AVG("s1"."m1") AS m1, AVG("s1"."m2") AS m2, AVG("s1"."m3") AS m3 FROM "s1" GROUP BY "s1"."g"
why: average of accessibility score per users within users.gendlbl
controversy score - quality score: both in points and of the same kind (stocks) on the same article
average of controversy score minus quality score per users within users.gendlbl
average of accessibility score minus average of controversy score minus quality score: both in points, of the same kind, from different quantities
coarsen to g: AVG (averaged), AVG (averaged), AVG (averaged)
